_meta.description: Crosstab count of region x segment decorated with TWO overlay layers — OVERLAY_SHARE_OF_COL and OVERLAY_SHARE_OF_TOTAL — that complete the matrix share triad alongside OVERLAY_SHARE_OF_ROW (02_crosstab_share_of_row.json). SHARE_OF_COL renormalises each cell into its share of the column margin (cell / col_margin) so cells along a single column sum to 1.0 — the 100%-stacked vertical projection. SHARE_OF_TOTAL renormalises into share of the grand total (cell / grand_total) so the entire matrix sums to 1.0 — the single-population share projection. Both kinds are CELL-scoped over the MATRIX host. Buffered (host crosstab orchestrator recomputes margins from raw rows before ApplyOverlays runs).
_meta.name: crosstab-share-of-col-and-total
